description: Figure 2 is a line plot that illustrates the relationship between the validation perplexity on the WikiText dataset and the value of the pruning parameter M for three different large language models: LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B. The models were pruned to achieve a 70% sparsity level using the OWL method. The x-axis, labeled "M", represents the pruning parameter and is scaled logarithmically, with values ranging from 1 to 100. The y-axis, labeled "Perplexity", represents the validation perplexity and is scaled linearly, with values ranging from 10 to 100. The plot displays three distinct lines, each corresponding to one of the models. The line for LLaMA1-7B (blue) shows a general upward trend, starting at a perplexity of approximately 14 when M=1 and increasing to about 55 when M=100. The line for LLaMA1-13B (orange) follows a similar trend, starting at a perplexity of around 15 and rising to approximately 56. The line for Vicuna-7B (green) exhibits a different pattern, starting at a higher perplexity of about 20 and increasing to roughly 60. All three lines show a consistent increase in perplexity as the value of M increases, indicating that a higher M value leads to a greater degradation in model performance.
